beats.headline: The hound had an owner before this one
beats.text: Subject was a god’s son and the owner of Orthrus, and he was murdered. His father’s quest names the obvious suspect, his own brother Hellik, and in the same breath admits that Hellik was in council with the rest of them when it happened.

beats.headline: A deal, and a witness
beats.text: Asked on behalf of Emberus what became of the god's son, Amayon, prince of Sheol, answers that he knows exactly what happened to the child and that he was witness to the deal being signed. Samantha has already supplied the name, Geyrun, and the word murdered. Amayon's price for the rest is help killing his three brothers, and he considers that speaking the offer aloud has delivered it to Emberus already.
